verdict.rationale: Fathom exposes an official MCP server that lets AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude query and act on meeting data via natural language (fathom-docs-10, 19, 25, 33-35), and pricing mentions a 'Conversational meeting assistant' feature (fathom-docs-29), supporting some natural-language operation. However, this is largely mediated through third-party AI assistants rather than a native NL command interface, and there's no detailed documentation of the scope/depth of commands supported. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a native conversational/command interface within the Fathom app itself, examples of natural-language commands and their effects, and independent verification of the conversational assistant feature.
